== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle (Errata)]]: the PC card image of [[Zuckuss With Snare Rifle]] (2 August 2024, [[:File:V23-D-zuckusswithsnarerifle.gif|V23-D-zuckusswithsnarerifle.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (page 1). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
